assay: bulk mRNA-seq of vastus lateralis biopsies, human males (S2.5.5.2.p1)
design: randomized double-blind 2x2 crossover of OLE (Active) vs placebo; between-subject exercise type MICE (n=10) or SIE (n=10); biopsies Pre, Post, 24h in each crossover period (S2.2.p1, S2.4.p1, S2.5.5.3.p1)
sample_inclusion: all 119 available biopsies (19 subjects x 6, one subject x 5) in one model (S2.5.5.3.p1)
primary_estimand: exercise effect on muscle mRNA within the placebo arm: Post vs Pre and 24h vs Pre, separately for MICE and SIE (S3.3.p1; FIG4 legend: response with placebo ingestion)
planned_contrasts: MICE placebo Post vs Pre (S3.3.p1; 3883 DEGs)
secondary_estimands: OLE effect corrected for exercise at Post and 24h (S3.4.p1, FIG6) - not the exercise question; only exploratory comparisons
paper_method: edgeR filterByExpr + TMM, limma voomWithQualityWeights, duplicateCorrelation (twice) on donor, BH (S2.5.5.3.p2)
